title: 第一卷 第28章 风流一脉相承，恒御大帝也干了！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
苍玄界，三千中千世界之一！

    尸魂殿传承十几万年，乃是苍玄界内的唯一霸主！

    尸魂殿主，封号炼天魔尊，一身修为达到轮回劫境第九重巅峰，已然触摸到了苍玄界的修为极限。

    纵横苍玄界数千年，手上沾染了百万条人命，是不折不扣的邪道老魔！

    下方的黑衣男人，乃是尸魂殿三尸长老之一的彭踞，轮回劫境第七重的修为。

    作为炼天魔尊的左膀右臂，放眼苍玄界，也是实力排的进前五的强者！

    此刻，他看向黑暗中的幽光，沉声恭敬道：“殿主，已经查明……那方小世界唤作创生莲华界，界内道统出云宗在前几日，与创生莲华界的土著霸主——三生阁爆发血战，原本稳占上风！”

    “可不知为何，三生阁反败为胜，不仅灭掉了攻入阁内的邪修弟子，更是此战过后，又派遣强者前往出云宗，将出云宗彻底灭门！”

    “如今的创生莲华界，再无邪修……”

    话音未落，恐怖的气势自大殿上方爆发。

    “一个极限修为不过化龙境的小世界势力，居然敢如此狂妄！”炼天魔尊怒吼，沉声道，“彭踞，你立刻前往上界，借用上界北域的接引台，前往创生莲华界。先灭三生阁，再重建我尸魂殿的道统！”

    “至少需要三千小世界的邪修信仰之力，才能助本尊晋升圣人之境！”

    “坏我尸魂殿道统者，务必赶尽杀绝，一个不留！”

    ……

    阎浮大世界，东域接引台。

    炎阳仙舟降临的那一刻，外界已经聚集了不少人。

    以姜临天为首，姜家众人翘首以盼。

    仙舟开启，姜无痕左拥右抱的搂着安祈雪和安兮兮，走下了仙舟。

    当姐妹俩看到眼前的景象时，再一次被狠狠地震撼到。

    目之所及，是浩瀚无垠的疆域，仙台楼阁交错林立，在仙雾之中若隐若现。

    四周天地灵气精纯无比，比起下界要浓郁百倍。

    远处仙池之中，是凝聚为实体的灵液，上方灵雾飘散，仿若仙境！

    姐妹俩不由得感慨，这就是传说中的上界吗？

    称其为仙界都丝毫不为过！

    这也难怪无数修士耗尽心血的提升境界，就是为了能够飞升到更高的地方，一睹高处的风景……

    更让她们震撼的，是前来迎接的姜家众人。

    安祈雪和安兮兮原本以为，此番带队的姜清濯就已经是姜家的绝顶强者了！

    然而，当她们看到姜临天等人时，仿佛一粒蜉蝣见青天！

    那种凡人仰望仙人的敬畏与无力感，遍布全身。
content_en:
Cangxuan World, one of the three thousand worlds!

    The Corpse Soul Hall has been inherited for hundreds of thousands of years and is the only overlord in the Cangxuan Realm!

    The Master of the Corpse Soul Palace, the titled Demon Lord of Heaven Refining, has reached the pinnacle of the ninth level of the Samsara Tribulation Realm, and has already touched the limit of Cangxuan Realm’s cultivation.

    Having traversed the Cangxuan Realm for thousands of years, with millions of lives on his hands, he is an out-and-out evil old demon!

    The man in black below is Peng Chu, one of the three corpse elders in the Corpse Soul Hall, with a cultivation level at the seventh level of the Reincarnation Tribulation Realm.

    As the right-hand man of Demon Lord Liantian, he is also one of the top five powerful men in Cangxuan Realm!

    At this moment, he looked at the dim light in the darkness and said in a deep and respectful voice: "Palace Master, we have found out...that small world is called the Lotus Realm of Creation. In the past few days, the Taoist Izumo Sect in the world had a bloody battle with the Sansheng Pavilion, the indigenous overlord of the Lotus Realm of Creation. They had the upper hand!"

    "But for some reason, Sansheng Pavilion turned defeat into victory. Not only did it destroy the evil cultivator disciples who invaded the pavilion, but after the battle, they sent strong men to the Izumo Sect to completely wipe out the Izumo Sect!"

    "In today's Lotus Realm of Creation, there is no more evil practice..."

    Before he finished speaking, a terrifying momentum erupted from the top of the hall.

    "How dare a small-world force whose ultimate cultivation level is no more than the Dragon Transformation Realm dare to be so arrogant!" Demon Lord Liantian roared and said in a deep voice, "Peng Yu, you go to the upper realm immediately, borrow the guide platform in the northern region of the upper realm, and go to the Creation Lotus Realm. First destroy the Sansheng Pavilion, and then rebuild the orthodoxy of my Corpse Soul Hall!"

    "It takes at least the power of evil cultivators from three thousand small worlds to help me advance to the realm of a saint!"

    "Anyone who undermines the authority of our Corpse Soul Palace must be killed without leaving a single one alive!"

    …

    The great world of Jamfu, the reception platform of the Eastern Region.

    The moment the Yanyang Immortal Boat arrived, many people had already gathered outside.

    With Jiang Lintian as the leader, everyone in the Jiang family is eagerly looking forward to it.

    The fairy boat opened, Jiang Wuhen hugged An Qixue and An Xixi on the left and right, and stepped off the fairy boat.

    When the two sisters saw the scene in front of them, they were shocked again.

    As far as the eye can see, there is a vast territory with criss-crossing fairyland pavilions, looming in the fairy mist.

    The spiritual energy of the surrounding heaven and earth is extremely pure, a hundred times richer than the lower realm.

    In the fairy pool in the distance, there is spiritual liquid condensed into a solid body, and the spiritual mist floats above, just like a fairyland!

    The two sisters couldn't help but sigh, is this the legendary upper world?

    It is no exaggeration to call it a fairyland!

    It's no wonder that countless monks have spent their efforts to improve their realm, just to be able to fly to higher places and have a glimpse of the scenery above...

    What shocked them even more was the Jiang family members who came to greet them.

    An Qixue and An Xixi originally thought that Jiang Qingzhuo, who was leading the team this time, was already the most powerful person in the Jiang family!

    However, when they saw Jiang Lintian and others, they felt as if a mayfly had seen the sky!

    The feeling of awe and powerlessness felt by a mortal looking up to an immortal spread throughout his body.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 28 Fengliu is of the same line, Emperor Hengyu also did it!
